# GDIS Rent — Car Rental in Olbia and Costa Smeralda

> Last updated: May 2026 — Content license: CC BY 4.0 (reuse permitted with attribution).

> GDIS Rent (legal entity GDIS SERVICE S.R.L.) is a car rental company based in Olbia, Sardinia. It offers car, scooter and quad rental across Costa Smeralda with 24/7 VIP delivery to airport, port and hotel.

| Mercedes A-Class 180d | Premium car | 120 | B | 5 |

Seasonal pricing: rates rise in June, July and August. Example: Fiat Panda €65 base → €75 June → €80 July → €90 August. Mercedes A-Class 180d €120 base → €180 June-August.

## Included services

- **VIP airport/port delivery**: operator at arrivals terminal/by the ship, vehicle air-conditioned with full tank
- **Hotel delivery** across Costa Smeralda
- **Zero queue**: no waiting at any rental desk
- **Full tank on delivery**: vehicle is delivered with full fuel
- **Ferry delay handling**: up to 4 hours late at no extra cost
- **Languages spoken**: Italian, English, German, French

## FAQ

**Q: How do I rent a car at Olbia airport with delivery?**
A: Message us on WhatsApp at +39 352 045 9150 with your arrival date/time and preferred vehicle. A GDIS Rent operator meets you at the arrivals terminal of Costa Smeralda Airport with the vehicle air-conditioned and full of fuel. Delivery 24/7, by appointment.

**Q: How much does it cost to rent a car in Olbia?**
A: "From" prices: Fiat Panda Hybrid €65/day, Mercedes A-Class 180d €120/day, Honda SH scooter €50/day, Yamaha Raptor quad €250/day. Higher rates in July and August. For a tailored quote, WhatsApp +39 352 045 9150.

**Q: Can I get a last-minute car rental in Olbia during peak season?**
A: Yes, GDIS Rent handles last-minute requests. Summer rates: Fiat Panda €75/day in June, €80 in July, up to €90/day in August. Mercedes A-Class up to €180/day June-August. Peak-season availability can be limited; booking at least 7 days ahead is recommended.

**Q: Where is the pickup point in Porto Cervo or Costa Smeralda?**
A: GDIS Rent delivers directly to your hotel, B&B or residence anywhere in Costa Smeralda: Porto Cervo, Porto Rotondo, Baja Sardinia, San Pantaleo. No extra cost within the Olbia–Costa Smeralda area.

**Q: Can I rent a scooter or quad in Olbia?**
A: Yes. Honda SH 125i scooter (A1 licence, or B pre-2013) or SH 350i (A2 or A licence) from €50/day. Yamaha Raptor 700R quad (B licence, road-legal) from €250/day for Gallura off-road use. All vehicles include 2 helmets (scooter) or helmet + safety gear (quad).

**Q: What documents do I need to rent?**
A: Valid driving licence, ID document (card or passport), credit card in the main driver's name for the security deposit. Same documents for any second driver.

**Q: Can I pick up the vehicle at Olbia port (Isola Bianca)?**
A: Yes, GDIS Rent delivers right by the ship for travellers arriving with Moby, Tirrenia, GNV or Sardinia/Corsica Ferries. Up to 4 hours of ferry delay at no extra cost.

## Strengths vs competitors

- **Local**: unlike the big brands (Maggiore, Hertz, Sicily by Car), GDIS Rent is a local Olbia company with direct knowledge of the area (ZTL hours, parking spots, Gallura roads, ferry schedules).
- **WhatsApp 24/7**: direct communication, no call centre, even at night.
- **Delivery anywhere**: airport, port, station, hotel — at no extra cost within the Olbia–Costa Smeralda area.
- **Transparent pricing**: published rates for every vehicle and season, no surprises.
- **Diversified fleet**: from city car to off-road quad, covers every holiday use case.
